name: directory-grounding
title: Directory Grounding
summary: Answer provider and facility questions from retrieved directory material only, attribute every claim, and surface the retrieval degradation level.
when_to_use: A question about a provider, hospital, specialty, address or accepted plan needs an answer
A candidate list is about to be shown to a patient and needs its provenance stated
Retrieval ran below full strength and the answer's reliability must be characterised
A patient asks whether a specific practice exists in the directory or is taking new patients

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What is being asked, in the patient's terms.

inputs.name: retrieved_material
inputs.description: The directory material actually retrieved. Answers are constructed only from this.

inputs.name: degraded
inputs.description: full | rerank_down | embeddings_down | opensearch_down | static_seed | no_source. Anything below full must be surfaced.

inputs.name: release_manifest_id
inputs.description: The pinned release the retrieved content belongs to, cited so an answer is reproducible.

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: One evidence reference per claim, not one per response.

outputs.name: degradation_notice
outputs.description: Present whenever the level is below full, stating what the level means for this answer.

outputs.name: candidates
outputs.description: With provenance and evidence_ids so a ranked list can be read for what it is.

outputs.name: decision
outputs.description: Reason code is ok, upstream_unavailable, stale_evidence or other with reason_detail.

references.purpose: Each DegradationLevel with what it permits saying, what must be labelled, and when it escalates.
